title: Just left the mall
content: Soooo I was in the mall. The dream started I was at some apartment complex getting ready for a conference? We were going over what happened the night before when we were all out doing molly. (I havnt done molly in 20 years…) I didn’t know anyone there irl but knew everyone while in the dream. Then we went downstairs and it was some kind of art conference. We were given a list of words by silent people behind a counter. We were supposed to draw a picture based on the words. I remember the first one was “zero”. And “diamonds” but progressively got more emotionally charged. Then I heard a gunshot in the distance. Everyone was slow to react. As if they were waiting for others to do so. Eventually chaos broke out but the gunshots sounded like they were coming over a loud speaker. Like an experiment. I woke up shortly after that but while thinking about this I’ve started to remember more about the dream well fragments that are hard to place sequentially.
